lead.en: Soi Sena Ruam — officially Phahon Yothin Soi 11 — is a residential side-soi grid in Phaya Thai strung along the Phahonyothin corridor: two private hospitals and a compound park at the edges, Villa Market and La Villa within 700 m, craft bars spilling in from the Ari end, and a BTS station that has been 'coming' since 1999 and still adds 25 baht to the fare table in 2026.

strengths.en: Everyday completeness at short distances: Prasanmit hospital about 149 m and Vimut about 310 m on the road frontage, Villa Market at 310 m, Big C and Lotus's within the 800 m sweep, and 100 essentials counted inside the cell.

A documented cafe-and-bar strip instead of a nightlife district: the Ari-Saphan Khwai corridor carries the venues behind nightlife 9 — Dumbo, Honest Mistake and BRUT map inside the cell — while BAANLYY scores Saphan Khwai nightlife 8/10 and Time Out lists Ari's low-lit bars.

Low-rise residential texture with a published identity: BK Magazine's 2018 soi guide ('could be the new Ari') and Time Out's 'quiet residential sois shaded from the heat' match the grid the app scores.
Clean district math: the cell sits entirely in Phaya Thai — Chatuchak starts just north at Saphan Khwai — split roughly half-and-half between the Phaya Thai and Sam Sen Nai khwaengs.

tradeoffs.en: There is no station. BTS Ari is 734 m and Saphan Khwai 929 m away, both in other cells; transport 8 rests on an app model that treats the unbuilt N6 'Sena Ruam' as an operating stop.

The missing station still costs money: BTSC's fare table counts N6, so the 1.6 km Saphan Khwai-Ari hop runs 25 baht — called out in the Bangkok Metropolitan Council in November 2026 as more than longer extension hops.
Green is thin and off-center: the only named park (the Public Relations Department public park, about 1.95 ha mapped) sits at the cell's south-west margin, its centroid 871 m from the center.
September 2026 flooding hit this Phahonyothin stretch hard enough to bring in army detachments to clear flood-damaged vehicles — a live risk no score input carries.

dayNight.en: Daytime rhythm is medical and commuter: hospital traffic at Prasanmit and Vimut, buses along Phahonyothin, and the soi cafes that served office workers when BK Magazine profiled the street in 2018.
Evenings import their crowd: the mapped bars (Dumbo 339 m, Honest Mistake 323 m, BRUT 545 m) draw the Ari-Saphan Khwai strip's customers while the soi itself stays residential.

Weekends read cafe-first: the soi's four 2018-era independent cafes (Caffe Undici, Doctor Roaster, PH1b, Before Thirtieth) set the register; only the attached hotel's survival (Craftsman Bangkok) is corroborated for 2026.
When the trains are far away, the corridor is bus-and-road territory — and the September 2026 flood showed how quickly the main road can stop.

variation.en: East of Phahonyothin (Sam Sen Nai khwaeng side): the hospital frontage, Vimut, the school and a denser shophouse grid — close to half the cell.
West of Phahonyothin (Phaya Thai khwaeng side): the Soi Sena Ruam cafe grid and, at the far margin, the Public Relations Department park.
The south-west corner thins toward La Villa and Ari's cell boundary; the north edge runs to Saphan Khwai's retail, with Big C and Lotus's just outside the polygon.
The center point itself — where the N6 station would have risen in front of Prasanmit — is the cell's transit dead center: no station, no square, just the primary road.

fit.en: Fits: hospital workers and patients, renters priced out of Ari proper who want the same cafe-soi texture at corridor rents, and anyone whose day runs along Phahonyothin by bus.
Poor fit: anyone choosing this cell for BTS at the door — the stations are outside it, the fare table charges for the gap, and the promised station has no schedule.
Families get the quiet-soi logic (schools at 665-703 m, low-rise housing) but should weigh the 2026 flood record on the main road against it.

uncertainties: The 49-venue nightlife count (Overture) could not be decomposed; OSM maps 11 named bars, so whatever sits behind the difference (shophouse pubs, lounges, karaokes) is unverified.
The app's rent figures are a district blend; BAANLYY's indicative 2-bed floor (38,000) sits above the blend's 37,000, and no signed-rent data exists for the cell's own stock.
The Public Relations Department park's public-access status and hours were not verified, and its centroid lies outside the scored polygon.
BK Magazine's 2018 venue list may be partly stale; only Craftsman Bangkok's survival is corroborated for 2026.
Bus route numbers serving the soi-mouth stops were not sourced, and khlong-boat access was not checked (app fact: piers 0).

Whether N6 construction ever starts is genuinely open: the infobox says construction expected 2026 and service 2032, the same article's history says cancelled, and the BMA said in November 2026 only that it will coordinate.

temporal.observed: stable since the app snapshot (2026-10); the underlying planning history is stable since 1999

limitations: The app snapshot is internal project data, not an external source; its presentation as an operating station is reported here as app behaviour, verified against OSM.
OSM coverage of railways is generally strong in Bangkok, but absence of a station node is a negative claim from mapping data.
Thai Wikipedia's own cited sources for the article are 2018-2020 vintage; the 2026 construction-start expectation is unverified by news.

temporal.observed: Council question of 4 Nov 2026; planning record since 1999

limitations: Single-outlet report; no independent second news account of the hearing was found in this session.
The fare figure is quoted from the councilor's statement, not from a fare table.
Ratchayothin (N11) and Phahonyothin 24 (N10) opening dates are carried by the 4 December 2019 phase rather than by dedicated page reads this session.
The 5 June 2020 'four more stations' figure comes from one Wikipedia page; segment-by-segment dating was not independently confirmed.

temporal.observed: Static geometry of the app snapshot

limitations: Polygon vertex count and clipping are the coordinator's geometry checks to confirm independently (check_geometry.py).
'Inside the 800 m circle but outside the polygon' items are counted by the app's fact pipeline for some scores — flagged in open_issues.

temporal.observed: Boundaries as mapped in OSM (stable administrative lines)

limitations: Estimate is sampling-based (roughly ±1-2 pp at this grid density).
OSM lacks a khwaeng relation named แขวงพหลโยธิน (queried); the mapped khwaeng set near the cell is what the split rests on.
A Thai-language search result independently described Soi Sena Ruam as being in แขวงสามเสนใน (snippet-only), consistent with the mapped split.
Bus route numbers serving these stops were not sourced in this session.
Khlong Prem Prachakhon boat pier distances were not checked; the canal was not part of this session's queries.
OSM bar tagging undercounts small shophouse venues; Overture categories could not be inspected from here.
A 4.5x gap between sources is unresolved — the 49 figure stands (per brief) but its composition is unknown (open issue).
Inference, not a measured venue census; the Overture mix behind the app's 49 remains unverified.
Ari's bar scene is well documented; which specific venues drive the app's count inside this cell is unknown.
BAANLYY lists no cons at all — its positivity is a pro-bias risk (property portal).
Time Out's Ari framing covers the neighbourhood node, not the scored cell.
The park's public accessibility and opening hours were not verified; the OSM name asserts 'public park' but the compound is a government department's ground.
Park-to-station adjacency at Mo Chit was not independently verified beyond the station node's placement.
App 1.8 ha vs OSM 1.95 ha difference is unexplained (partial-in-cell counting vs full polygon).
Vimut's May 2021 opening date and address come from search-result summaries (snippet-only; no full read) — flagged; OSM placement is the load-bearing evidence.
OSM's outdated hospital name (pre-2009) is a data-hygiene issue logged in open_issues.
The earlier rename history (TB-association hospital, 1994/2009 renames) rests on snippet-level sources and is not load-bearing here.
The unnamed OSM marketplace could not be identified by name in this session.
Convenience-store chains (7-Eleven etc.) mapped inside the polygon were not individually listed.
Portal ranges are indicative, not medians; no signed-rent data exists in this bundle.
The comparison is guide-vs-blend, not a measured unit-level rent.

temporal.observed: Guide dated 2018-05-24; 2026 corroboration via Time Out

limitations: Eight-year-old venue list — individual closures/openings unverified except Craftsman Bangkok.

A Thai-language search result (snippet-only) independently gave the Soi Phahonyothin 11 equivalence and listed condos on the soi (Harmony Living 2007, Chateau In Town); those condo names were not verified.

temporal.observed: Single event; seasonal monsoon risk recurring

limitations: Depth, duration and resident-experience details circulated in search results could not be tied to stable links and are excluded from the claim text.
No BMA rainfall or drainage statistics were pulled for the event.

temporal.observed: Window searched 2024-2026 plus older dedicated hits

limitations: A negative coverage claim is bounded by search-tool coverage; no Thai city magazine beyond BK/Time Out was systematically swept.
The 2018 BK guide and the 2026 corridor guides are the entire editorial set for the strip found in this session.
